text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити loses to Тамамо Кросс and
realizes
how poorly she has been running
up to now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, for the first time, she
experiences true
frustration. She has
been so concerned about the
voices of
those around her that she wasn't

listening to her own heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But now, she hears her heart scream with
the pure
desire to both run and win
more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The racecourse is where she wants to be,
and her
manager, moved to tears by the
heartfelt joy she
displayed on the track,
agrees that she should
continue racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen, the
final race of
the Senior Spring Triple
Crown and our chance to
show Tamamo
Cross what Голд Сити's really made
of!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
